facts.text: The wrapper drives a Vortran Stradus laser over RS-232/COM
Every command must terminate with a carriage return '\r' or 0x0D to be processed
A command with a value is sent as 'CMD=value' and a command without one as 'CMD', both plus the carriage return
A reply is parsed as the command name, '=', and the values separated by ', '
All replies to commands are in upper case
The command vocabulary is the four lists GLOBAL_CMD, GLOBAL_QUERY, LASER_CMD and LASER_QUERY
Emission is switched with LE: 1 = on, 0 = off; the setter sends 'LE=<value>'
turn_on and turn_off are aliases that set the emission toggle to 1 and 0
The emission delay is a 5 second delay toggled with DELAY: 1 = on, 0 = off
Laser power is set with LP and read with ?LP; it requires pulse mode to be off
The power setter clamps the requested value to the maximum power read from the head
Maximum laser power is queried with ?MAXP
Pulse mode is toggled with PUL: 1 = on
The status query returns a fault code (?FC) and a fault description (?FD)
The wrapper identifies the head with ?LI: the serial number and the head's data fields
The wrapper opens the port with a default baud rate of 19200
